title: Ambient directional derivative of a Lipschitz function along a chart differential (Simon Ch. 2, 4.10)
statement: Let n, P ∈ ℕ (ℝᵏ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)), let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be L-Lipschitz (L ∈ ℝ≥0), and let Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P and w ∈ ℝⁿ be such that Φ is Fréchet differentiable at w and f∘Φ is Fréchet differentiable at w. Then for every u ∈ ℝⁿ the function s ↦ f(Φ(w) + s·DΦ(w)u) (s ∈ ℝ) is differentiable at s = 0 with derivative D(f∘Φ)(w)u, where DΦ(w) = fderiv ℝ Φ w and D(f∘Φ)(w) = fderiv ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w.
lean_statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (w : Eucl n), LipschitzWith L f → DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ w → DifferentiableAt ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w → ∀ u : Eucl n, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (Φ w + s • fderiv ℝ Φ w u)) (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w u) 0
